ops.label: Attractor
ops.doc: Glowing trails that fly round a looping butterfly or cloud, a strange attractor: points fly along a Lorenz butterfly, or hop across a Clifford cloud of filaments that slowly morphs, and their glow builds up and fades as the figure turns about the upright axis. `count` points glow for `trail` and turn at `spin`. On a panel the butterfly faces front, wings upright, and the flat Clifford cloud lies in the panel's plane and turns in it. Brightness is the glow against its mean over the lit cells, so a few heads and a dense cloud read alike.
ops.fix: a strip shows only a line through it; use lissajous or particles

params.name: kind
params.label: Kind
params.help: Lorenz: a butterfly ribbon in 3D; Clifford: a flat cloud of filaments

params.name: count
params.label: Count
params.help: Points it draws: a few ribbons, or a dense cloud

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast it moves: Lorenz points fly, a Clifford cloud morphs

params.name: spin
params.label: Spin
params.help: How fast the figure turns

params.name: size
params.label: Size
params.help: Radius of each point's glow

params.name: trail
params.label: Trail
params.help: How long its glow lasts

ops.label: Below
ops.doc: The frame of the layers below this one, as blended so far: a layer whose program starts here is an effect on the stack below it.

ops.label: Chase
ops.doc: Waves of color that chase round and round across the lights: a cyclic cellular automaton, each point counting round its steps and moving on a step when a neighbor is one step ahead. `states` sets how many steps. From noise, waves and turning spirals form. On a strip or a small map the waves die out and the points settle, so `sparks` move points on at random, and each starts a new wave. It shows each point's step as a share of the cycle, so give it a palette whose ends match. With `cell` above 0 it runs on a grid of square cells laid over the map instead, each light showing the cell it is in, so waves cross the gaps between strips a few apart.

params.name: states
params.label: States
params.help: Steps in one cycle: more give wider bands, which settle sooner

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast the waves chase

params.name: sparks
params.label: Sparks
params.help: Points a second that move on by themselves, each starting a wave; at 0 a strip settles

params.name: cell
params.label: Cell
params.help: At 0 it runs on the lights; above 0 on square cells this many times the lights' mean spacing wide, laid over the map, so waves cross the gaps between strips

ops.label: Lissajous
ops.doc: Glowing heads that trace a looping knot through the room: a Lissajous figure, its own number of loops along each axis. `a`, `b` and `c` are the loops a cycle along x, y and z.

params.name: a
params.label: Loops across
params.help: How many times the knot crosses the room side to side

params.name: b
params.label: Loops up
params.help: How many times the knot rises and falls

params.name: c
params.label: Loops deep
params.help: How many times the knot comes near and goes far

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast the heads run round the knot

params.name: heads
params.label: Heads
params.help: Heads spaced evenly along the knot

params.name: width
params.label: Width
params.help: Size of each head's glow

ops.label: Metaballs
ops.doc: Soft blobs that wander the room and melt together where they meet.

params.name: count
params.label: Count
params.help: How many blobs

params.name: radius
params.label: Radius
params.help: Size of each blob

params.name: smooth
params.label: Smooth
params.help: How far apart blobs start to melt together

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast the blobs wander

params.name: glow
params.label: Glow
params.help: Softness of the blobs' edges

ops.label: Noise
ops.doc: Smooth random hills that slowly change, finer ones on top. `octaves` sets how many finer layers, and `speed` how fast they change.

params.name: scale
params.label: Scale
params.help: How many hills fit across; more is finer

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast the hills change

params.name: octaves
params.label: Octaves
params.help: Finer detail on top of the hills

params.name: kind
params.label: Kind
params.help: Gradient noise is smoother; value noise is blockier

ops.label: Oscillator
ops.doc: Stripes along one axis that travel across the room.

params.name: freq
params.label: Stripes
params.help: More stripes across the room

params.name: sync
params.label: Travel
params.help: How fast the stripes travel: crests a second past each point; below 0 they run back

params.name: offset
params.label: Offset
params.help: Moves the stripes along by part of a crest

params.name: axis
params.label: Axis
params.help: Which way the stripes run; u runs along a strip from its first light

params.name: shape
params.label: Shape
params.help: Sine rises and falls; saw climbs from 0 to 1, then jumps back to 0, so a palette wraps round

ops.label: Particles
ops.doc: Sparks that drift, rise and fade: up to 256 at once, each born where the emit choice says, setting off in a random direction, falling or rising, drifting on a breeze and fading in and out. `rate` are born a second, each sets off at `speed`, falls or rises under `gravity`, drifts on a curl-noise breeze (`swirl`), and fades over its `life`. Sparks fly fast from the center and fall; snow drifts down from the top; fireflies hang anywhere and wander.

params.name: rate
params.label: Rate
params.help: More sparks at once

params.name: life
params.label: Life
params.help: Seconds each lives, fading in and out

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast each spark sets off, in a random direction

params.name: gravity
params.label: Gravity
params.help: Pull upward: above 0 up, below 0 down

params.name: swirl
params.label: Swirl
params.help: How fast the breeze they drift on swirls

params.name: emit
params.label: Emit
params.help: Where they are born: the center, along the bottom or top edge, or anywhere

params.name: size
params.label: Size
params.help: Radius of each particle's glow

ops.label: Prev
ops.doc: The layer's own last frame: with a fade or a color op after it, a trail (feedback with no warp).

ops.label: Quasicrystal
ops.doc: Patterns with many-fold symmetry that never repeat: waves from several evenly turned directions, summed. `waves` sets how many directions.
ops.fix: a strip shows only swelling stripes; use oscillator

params.name: waves
params.label: Waves
params.help: Directions of the waves; 5 and 7 never repeat

params.name: scale
params.label: Scale
params.help: Higher: more, smaller waves

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast the waves move

params.name: plane
params.label: Plane
params.help: Which two axes it works across; auto picks the room's

ops.label: Reaction
ops.doc: Coral, dividing cells, spots or a maze that grow across the lights from a few seeds: two chemicals that feed, react and spread. Brighter is more of the second chemical.

params.name: kind
params.label: Kind
params.help: Coral, mitosis, spots or maze

params.name: size
params.label: Size
params.help: How big its shapes grow

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast it grows

params.name: seeds
params.label: Seeds
params.help: New seeds a second at random points

ops.label: Ripple
ops.doc: A pond across the lights: drops fall at random points, and rings spread from each along the points, bounce off the ends and die away. Still water is 0.5; a crest is brighter, a trough darker. A drop lifts its point as much as it lowers the rest, and the whole pond settles at `damping`, so the water stays level however long it runs.

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast the rings spread

params.name: damping
params.label: Damping
params.help: How quickly ripples fade

params.name: drops
params.label: Drops
params.help: How often a drop falls, each at a random point

params.name: size
params.label: Size
params.help: Bigger splashes

ops.label: Shape
ops.doc: A filled circle or regular polygon at the room's center: a sphere in a volume, a segment on a strip.

params.name: sides
params.label: Sides
params.help: Corners; fewer than 3 draws a circle

params.name: radius
params.label: Radius
params.help: Size from the center to the rim or a corner

params.name: smooth
params.label: Smooth
params.help: Softness of the edge

params.name: plane
params.label: Plane
params.help: Which two axes it works across; auto picks the room's

ops.label: Voronoi
ops.doc: Cells around scattered points: bright at each point fading to its cell's rim, or bright rims between the cells. `edge` draws the rims.

params.name: scale
params.label: Scale
params.help: Cells across the room; more is smaller

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast the cells move

params.name: edge
params.label: Edge
params.help: 0 lights each cell's middle; 1 lights the borders between cells

ops.label: Dither
ops.doc: Breaks hard edges into a sparkle: each light reads the pattern a little off its own spot, and jumps to a new spot now and then, on a clock of its own. Where the pattern is flat nothing changes; at an edge a light twinkles between the colors on each side, as often as the edge covers its spot, so a hard edge reads as glitter and an edge that moves shimmers across the lights rather than stepping from one to the next. `amount` sets how far a light reaches, in the spacing of the lights along each axis, and `rate` how often each light jumps.

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.help: How far each light reaches: 0.5 is halfway to its neighbours; more sparkles wider

params.name: rate
params.label: Rate
params.help: Jumps a second for each light: more twinkles faster; above about 2 an edge can flash

ops.label: Kaleidoscope
ops.doc: Folds a pattern into mirrored wedges about the center, as a kaleidoscope does. `sides` sets how many.
ops.fix: a strip has no plane to fold; use mirror along the strip

params.name: sides
params.label: Sides
params.help: More mirror slices

params.name: plane
params.label: Plane
params.help: Which two axes it works across; auto picks the room's

ops.label: Mirror
ops.doc: Mirrors one side of a pattern onto the other: folded along one axis, at a point you set. `centre` sets where.

params.name: axis
params.label: Axis
params.help: The direction it folds across; u folds a strip along its wiring

params.name: centre
params.label: Center
params.help: Where the fold sits, from the low end (0) to the high end (1)

ops.label: Polar
ops.doc: Bends a pattern into rings and spokes round the center: stripes along x become rings and stripes along y become spokes. In polar coordinates, the plane's first axis becomes the radius and its second the turn.
ops.fix: a strip has no plane to wrap round; use mirror along the strip

params.name: plane
params.label: Plane
params.help: Which two axes it works across; auto picks the room's

ops.label: Repeat
ops.doc: Tiles a pattern across the room, each tile showing the whole of it, along one axis or all of them. `count` sets how many tiles.

params.name: count
params.label: Count
params.help: Tiles along the axis

params.name: axis
params.label: Axis
params.help: The axis it tiles along, or all of them

ops.label: Rotate
ops.doc: Turns a pattern about the center, to an angle and on at a speed. `angle` sets how far, `speed` how fast it keeps turning.
ops.fix: a strip has no plane to turn in; use scale or mirror along the strip

params.name: angle
params.label: Angle
params.help: Where it starts, before speed turns it on

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.help: Which way and how fast it keeps turning

params.name: plane
params.label: Plane
params.help: Which two axes it works across; auto picks the room's

ops.label: Scale
ops.doc: Zooms a pattern about the center: above 1 enlarges it.

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.help: Zoom: above 1 enlarges, below 1 shrinks

params.name: axis
params.label: Axis
params.help: The axis it zooms along, or all of them

ops.label: Tunnel
ops.doc: Rushes a pattern out of the center, as down a tunnel. It reads depth (1 / distance from the center) and turn, moving at `speed`.
ops.fix: a strip has no plane to look down; use scale along the strip (u)

params.name: depth
params.label: Depth
params.help: How deep the tunnel looks

params.name: speed
params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast it flies down the tunnel

params.name: core
params.label: Core
params.help: A still circle at the center, so the middle does not flicker

params.name: plane
params.label: Plane
params.help: Which two axes it works across; auto picks the room's

ops.label: Twist
ops.doc: Twists a volume into a corkscrew: each slice turned a little more than the one before it. Each turns about `axis` by `amount` degrees per unit along it.
ops.fix: twist turns the slices of a volume; on a panel use rotate, on a strip scale

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.help: Degrees of turn per unit along the axis

params.name: axis
params.label: Axis
params.help: The axis the slices turn about

ops.label: Contrast
ops.doc: Pushes colors away from the middle gray for more punch, or toward it for less.

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.help: Above 1 sharpens, below 1 flattens toward gray

ops.label: Hue
ops.doc: Turns every color's hue round the color wheel, keeping how light and how strong it is. `amount` sets how far, in degrees. A color turned past what LEDs show is clipped for red, green and blue separately, which moves its hue a little; a palette's `shift` turns its colors without that.

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.help: Degrees the hues turn

ops.label: Palette
ops.doc: Colors a pattern through a gradient: its lowest values take the first color and its highest the last. `shift` turns every color's hue, in steps of 0.5°, and a color it turns past what LEDs show gets less strong, never a different hue; `cycle` slides the colors along the field, wrapping round.

params.name: palette
params.label: Palette
params.help: Press a dot to edit its color; the left end colors the low parts, the right the high

params.name: shift
params.label: Shift
params.help: Turns every color's hue

params.name: cycle
params.label: Slide
params.help: Slides the colors along, round and round; give both ends one color for no seam

ops.label: Posterize
ops.doc: Bands instead of a smooth ramp: values rounded down to a few steps from 0 to 1. `levels` sets how many. On a fast-changing field the bands flicker.

params.name: levels
params.label: Levels
params.help: Steps from dark to bright

ops.label: Add
ops.doc: Adds two patterns, light on light. `b` goes onto `a`.

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.help: How much of the second pattern shows over the first

ops.label: Blend
ops.doc: Lays one pattern onto another, mixed as layers mix: the second onto the first. `b` goes onto `a`.

params.name: mode
params.label: Mode
params.help: How the second pattern mixes into the first

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.help: How much of the second pattern shows over the first

ops.label: Difference
ops.doc: Bright where two patterns disagree. It is the difference of `a` and `b`, for red, green and blue separately.

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.help: How much of the second pattern shows over the first

ops.label: Multiply
ops.doc: One pattern masks another: dark where the mask is dark. `a` is multiplied by `b`.

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.help: How much of the second pattern shows over the first

ops.label: Ripple
ops.doc: Ripples one pattern with another: each point moves as far as the second says there. Each point of `in` moves by `amount` times `mod`. A color's red, green and blue move x, y and z.

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.help: How strongly the second pattern warps the first

ops.label: Diffuse
ops.doc: Heat that bleeds from light to light: what it reads glows, spreads to the lights next to it (never across a gap with none) and fades.

params.name: bleed
params.label: Bleed
params.help: How fast the glow spreads to the next points

params.name: decay
params.label: Decay
params.help: How long the glow lasts

ops.label: Feedback
ops.doc: Trails that stream and fade: each frame what it showed moves (zooms, spins, swirls, drifts up, wobbles) and fades, and keeps the brighter of that and what it reads. On a strip it runs along the strip; spin and swirl turn a panel's plane, or a volume about its up axis.

params.name: decay
params.label: Decay
params.help: How long a trail lasts

params.name: zoom
params.label: Zoom
params.help: How much it grows a second: above 1 it streams out of the center, below 1 into it

params.name: spin
params.label: Spin
params.help: Which way and how fast it turns about the center; nothing on a strip

params.name: swirl
params.label: Swirl
params.help: Degrees a second the middle turns, falling off outward: a whirlpool; nothing on a strip

params.name: drift
params.label: Drift
params.help: How fast it flows upward (below 0, down)

params.name: warp
params.label: Warp
params.help: How much a slow noise wobbles the flow

ops.label: Trails
ops.doc: A trail behind anything that moves: each light keeps the brighter of the pattern and its own fading past. Per point, so cheap on any map; it has no value between the points, so no coord op may sit above it.

params.name: tail
params.label: Tail
params.help: How long a trail lasts

ops.label: Audio follower
ops.doc: How loud a part of the sound is, 0 to 1: the volume, or the bass, mid or high bands, times `gain`. It rises with time constant `attack` and falls with `release`, as an audio-reactive light smooths its levels (about 50 ms up and 200 ms down).

params.name: band
params.label: Band
params.help: The part of the sound it follows

params.name: gain
params.label: Boost
params.help: Turns the level up; it never goes past full

params.name: attack
params.label: Rise
params.help: How soon it follows the sound up

params.name: release
params.label: Release
params.help: How slowly it lets go as the sound falls

ops.label: Beat
ops.doc: The beat, 0 to 1: a `pulse` on for the first `width` of each beat, the beat's `phase` rising from 0 to 1, or a `fall` from 1 at each beat to 0 at the next.

params.name: shape
params.label: Shape
params.help: Pulse flashes on each beat; phase climbs through the beat; fall drops from each beat

params.name: width
params.label: Width
params.help: How much of each beat the pulse is on

ops.label: Envelope
ops.doc: An envelope its `gate` signal plays, 0 to 1: when the gate turns on (0.5 or more) it rises to 1 over `attack`, falls to `sustain` over `decay` and holds there; when the gate turns off it falls to 0 over `release`. On the beat: `beat().env(...)`.

params.name: attack
params.label: Rise
params.help: Seconds to rise from 0 to 1

params.name: decay
params.label: Decay
params.help: Seconds to fall from 1 to the sustain level

params.name: sustain
params.label: Sustain
params.help: The level it holds while the pulse lasts

params.name: release
params.label: Release
params.help: Seconds to fall to nothing after the pulse ends

ops.label: Macro
ops.doc: A value a person sets, 0 to 1. With several routes it is a macro: at 0 each knob it drives sits at its own value, and at 1 each has moved by its route's depth.

params.name: value
params.label: Value
params.help: A knob of the look's own: turn it to move what it drives

examples.py: look(layer("base", osc(8).kaleid(5).palette("ember")), routes=[(macro_ := knob(0.5).id("macro")).to("layers.base.osc.freq", depth=8), macro_.to("layers.base.kaleid.sides", depth=6)])

ops.label: LFO
ops.doc: A wave that swings from -1 to 1 `rate` times a second: a sine, a triangle, a square, a saw that falls or a ramp that rises. Each starts at 0 rising, but the square and the saw, which start at the top, and the ramp, at the bottom.

params.name: rate
params.label: Rate
params.help: Higher: what it moves swings faster

params.name: shape
params.label: Shape
params.help: Sine glides; square jumps; saw and ramp climb or fall, then jump back

params.name: offset
params.label: Offset
params.help: Moves the wave along by part of a cycle

ops.label: Smooth
ops.doc: Another signal, smoothed: it follows its input with a lag of `time` seconds (a one-pole filter), so a jump becomes a glide. Gives what its input gives.

params.name: time
params.label: Time
params.help: How long it takes to catch up

ops.label: Random
ops.doc: A smooth random wander from -1 to 1: it eases to a new random level `rate` times a second. The look's seed and the signal's id choose the levels, so a look wanders the same way on every run.

params.name: rate
params.label: Rate
params.help: How often it wanders somewhere new

blends.name: normal
blends.label: Normal
blends.doc: Shows the layer over what is below

blends.name: add
blends.label: Add
blends.doc: Adds the layer's light to what is below

blends.name: screen
blends.label: Screen
blends.doc: Adds light without washing out to white

blends.name: multiply
blends.label: Multiply
blends.doc: Darkens what is below where the layer is dark

blends.name: max
blends.label: Lighter
blends.doc: The brighter of the two, for red, green and blue separately

blends.name: min
blends.label: Darker
blends.doc: The darker of the two, for red, green and blue separately

blends.name: subtract
blends.label: Subtract
blends.doc: Takes the layer's light away from what is below

blends.name: stencil
blends.label: Stencil
blends.doc: Shows the layer where it has any color, what is below where it is black

blends.name: highlight
blends.label: Highlight
blends.doc: Lights only where what is below is already lit

kinds.doc: One of a fixed set of keys
